----- common params -----

-h,    --help, --usage                  print usage and exit
--version                               show version and build info
-t,    --threads N                      number of CPU threads to use during generation (default: -1)
                                        (env: LLAMA_ARG_THREADS)
-tb,   --threads-batch N                number of threads to use during batch and prompt processing
-C,    --cpu-mask M                     CPU affinity mask: arbitrarily long hex
-Cr,   --cpu-range lo-hi                range of CPUs for affinity
--cpu-strict <0|1>                      use strict CPU placement (default: 0)
-m,    --model FNAME                    model path
-ngl,  --n-gpu-layers N                 number of layers to store in VRAM, either an exact number, 'auto', or 'all'
-fa,   --flash-attn [on|off|auto]        set Flash Attention use
                                        (env: LLAMA_ARG_FLASH_ATTN)
-lm,   --load-mode MODE                 model loading mode (default: mmap)
                                        - none: no special loading mode
                                        - mmap: memory-map model
                                        - mlock: keep model in RAM
                                        - mmap+mlock: mmap and keep model in RAM
                                        - dio: use DirectIO if available
                                        (env: LLAMA_ARG_LOAD_MODE)
-ts,   --tensor-split N0,N1,N2,...      fraction of the model to offload to each GPU
--mmap                                  legacy mmap control
--no-mmap                               legacy mmap control
--mlock                                 legacy mlock control
--direct-io                             legacy direct I/O control
--perf, --no-perf                       whether to enable performance timings
-kvo,   --kv-offload, -nkvo, --no-kv-offload
                                        whether to enable KV cache offloading
--rope-scaling {none,linear,yarn}       RoPE frequency scaling method
--poll <0...100>                        polling level
-ctk,   --cache-type-k TYPE             KV cache data type for K
                                        allowed values: f32, f16, bf16, q8_0, q4_0, q4_1, iq4_nl
-dt,    --defrag-thold N                KV cache defragmentation threshold (DEPRECATED)
--rope-scale N                          RoPE context scaling factor
